bullets: A coalition of states is suing the Federal Emergency Management Agency and the Department of Homeland Security, accusing the Trump administration of withholding hundreds of millions of dollars in disaster-preparedness and homeland security grants to force states to adopt its policies on elections and immigration.

The complaint challenges new conditions imposed on the funding that would require states to verify voter citizenship through a federal database, move toward hand-marked paper ballots, conduct federally prescribed election audits and cooperate with federal immigration enforcement.

summaries.headline: DOJ withdraws subpoenas of NY Times journalists after judge’s rebuke
bullets: The Justice Department on Thursday withdrew subpoenas issued to journalists for The New York Times who reported on security issues with President Trump’s Qatari-gifted Air Force One after the department admitted to a series of missteps that an incredulous judge said would normally warrant sanctions.

The DOJ backed down on the demands at a Manhattan Federal Court hearing after Judge Arun Subramanian rebuked prosecutors over their procedures and the misleading representations they made in a mad dash to uncover the journalists’ sources.
